india.one_line: India’s AI landscape sees defence contracts, telecom policy drafts, and major funding and acquisition moves.

themes.title: Defence AI partnership signed
themes.text: Sarvam AI entered a five‑year MoU with India’s Ministry of Defence to develop AI for operational, training and decision‑support across the Army, Navy and Air Force.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications

themes.title: AI infrastructure funding sought
themes.text: AM Intelligence is seeking up to $3 billion, including bonds, loans and a $300 million advance, to finance its purchase of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin AI chips.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase

themes.title: Freshworks adds incident‑management AI
themes.text: Freshworks acquired Israel’s Robusta Dev, integrating AI‑driven outage diagnosis and remediation into its Freshservice IT service‑management platform.

stories.headline: Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to Freshservice
Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to boost incident management

themes.title: TRAI drafts telecom AI rules
themes.text: India’s Telecom Regulatory Authority released draft guidelines requiring telecom operators to classify AI by risk, obtain board approval, set up governance committees and report serious AI incidents.

stories.headline: TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms
